attr.title: LEGO Island
attr.desc: LEGO Island, portable: the 1997 open-world adventure rebuilt from the isledecomp decompilation. Explore the island, build vehicles, deliver pizzas, race and chase the Brickster.
attr.inst: Requires the LEGO Island (v1.1, English) CD. Copy the contents of the CD's LEGO folder into ports/legoisland/LEGO, then copy the DATA folder from the CD's DATA/DISK/LEGO folder into it, so ports/legoisland/LEGO contains SCRIPTS and DATA (about 450 MB).
